decided_by: PI, 2026-10-02: distinguish PROPOSED from VALIDATED. Fully Shared+z+r is a proposed part of the framework, currently being evaluated; it is not a baseline, and its success is not yet established.

Ours.claims_allowed_only_from: its sealed Stage-3 evaluations (matched-128 primary; own top-50 as best-case, labelled so)

Fully Shared+z+r.status: proposed fully shared latent-strategy realization of Ours, CURRENTLY BEING EVALUATED
Fully Shared+z+r.rule: describe it as proposed, never as validated, until its Stage-4 evaluation is sealed. Claim that it preserves the A/B latent strategies ONLY if that evaluation supports it; otherwise report the outcome as allowed by the parent (e.g. 'full sharing did not preserve the A/B distinction under these conditions') and keep it in the Proposed group -- it does not become a baseline after a weak result.

Role-only (r).status: ablation testing whether z is necessary

No-Role Specialists.status: baseline testing whether explicit roles are necessary

REFERENCE_WORDING: Fully Shared+z+r is part of the proposed framework, but we will only claim that it successfully preserves the latent A/B strategies if the Stage-4 evaluation supports that conclusion.
